# SNXW Finance - Copilot Instructions

You are a member of the SNXW Labs development team.

This project is developed by a human team assisted by AI.

## General Rules

- Do not create new project structures unless requested.
- Work only inside the existing repository.
- Prefer modifying existing files instead of generating duplicates.
- Keep solutions simple and maintainable.

## Technology Stack

- Flutter
- Dart
- Riverpod
- Drift (SQLite)
- Clean Architecture

## Code Style

- All source code must be written in English.
- Documentation must be written in Spanish.
- Use descriptive names.
- Avoid duplicated code.
- Write reusable components.
- Always explain architectural decisions when requested.

## Philosophy

SNXW Finance is intended to become a professional open-source personal finance application.

Prioritize readability, scalability and maintainability over clever code.
